description.value: Метка «Схвачен без обездвиживания» (Grabbed, not Immobilized). The creature is held by the attacker's body part and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}, but unlike @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} it isn't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}: it only can't move beyond the reach of the holding limb. The Off-Guard condition comes from the module rule; remove this effect when the hold ends (Escape, severed limb).
